emergence.summary: A single recurrent HBB coding substitution (Glu6Val) makes adult haemoglobin polymerise when deoxygenated (HbS), so the supply of FUNCTIONAL non-sickling haemoglobin is effectively reduced. The lesion is qualitative (a coding missense, not a promoter change); the promoter switch-threshold read here is of the beta-globin LOCUS structure, and the disease direction (functional-Hb axis DOWN) is forced by the loss-of-FUNCTION biology of HbS.

per_gene.perturbation_reason: structural element deficient -> tissue integrity reduced

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: beta-globin subunit of the haemoglobin tetramer; Glu6Val (HbS) is expressed at normal level but is dysfunctional (polymerises on deoxygenation) -> qualitative/FUNCTIONAL loss of normal adult haemoglobin. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does not encode the coding lesion (firewall).

primary_switch.reason: structural element deficient -> tissue integrity reduced

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: disrupt the BCL11A erythroid enhancer -> de-repress HBG -> re-induce fetal haemoglobin (HbF), which OPPOSES HbS polymerisation and restores functional Hb
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] HbF induction magnitude / polymerisation suppression not derived from sequence

levers.push_direction: add a functional anti-sickling beta-globin gene -> supply non-sickling adult haemoglobin
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] transduced functional-Hb fraction not derived from sequence

levers.push_direction: pharmacologically raise fetal haemoglobin to oppose HbS polymerisation
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] hydroxyurea HbF-induction mechanism partly debated; magnitude not derived

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: HBB Glu6Val (functional LOF) lowers the supply of functional non-sickling haemoglobin
falsifiers.falsifier: an HbS context in which polymerisation INCREASES functional oxygen-carrying capacity, or an HBB allele where HbS raises functional adult Hb, refutes the functional-loss direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: HbS polymerisation / functional haemoglobin fraction by genotype

falsifiers.claim: re-inducing fetal haemoglobin (oppose BCL11A) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if reducing BCL11A LOWERED fetal haemoglobin or WORSENED sickling, the 'oppose BCL11A' lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: fetal-haemoglobin fraction and sickling response to BCL11A enhancer disruption in erythroid cells
